recent_en: NWE Resources Group Berhad listed on the ACE Market on 21 October 2026 at an IPO price of RM0.20, with its share price rising on debut. The company reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with revenue of MYR 10.585 million and net profit of MYR 2.8 million. There were also several announcements on changes in directors' and management's shareholdings.
notable_en: The company listed on the ACE Market on 21 October 2026 at an IPO price of RM0.20, with a public issue of 143,145,540 new shares.
The company reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with revenue of MYR 10.585 million, net profit of MYR 2.8 million, and a net margin of 26.5%.
The Independent Non-Executive Chairman, two Independent Non-Executive Directors, and the Group Finance Manager subscribed for IPO shares under the Pink Form Allocation.
risks_en: The Group Finance Manager disposed of 200,000 ordinary shares (0.037%) on 21 October 2026 for RM43,678.80.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 10.585 million, net profit was MYR 2.8 million, and net margin was 26.5%.
